div.head: Leis Wl 14.3
div.ab: E li apelur jurra sur lui par VII humes numez sei siste main, que pur haur nel fait ne pur auter chose se pur sun dreit nun purchacer.
E li apeleur jurra sur lui [pe]r set homes només . . ., que pur haur nel fist ne pur altre chose si pur soun dreit noun purchacer.
Et appellator per VII legales homines ex nomine iurabit, quod nec ex odio nec alia aliqua causa hoc ei imponit nisi tantum ut ius suum adipiscatur.
E li apelur jurra sur lui par VII humes numez sei siste main, que pur haur nel fait ne pur auter chose se pur sun dreit nun purchacer.

14, 3. Und der Kläger soll gegen ihn durch 7 [vom Gericht] ernannte Männer selbsechster Hand schwören, dass er es nicht aus Hass thut (that I) und aus keiner anderen Ursache, sondern nur sein Recht zu erlangen.

14, 3. And the plaintiff shall swear against him by 7 men nominated [by the court], with himself as sixth hand, that he does (did I) not do it out of hatred and for no other cause, but only to obtain his right.

And the plaintiff shall swear by means of 7 men nominated [by the court], of whom 5 must act as his compurgators, that he does nothing through malice or for any other reason than to obtain his legal right.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 260–261 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text and German translation added from Gesetze I p. 502–503, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)

note.seg: den Sechser-Voreid erwähnt auch II Cn. 30, 3a erst als Ordal eintritt; ebenso Iud. Dei X 21{b}
the six-man fore-oath is also mentioned by II Cn. 30, 3a only when the ordeal comes in; likewise Iud. Dei X 21{b}
Der Satz ist, laut des Ind. Fut. des Verbs, nicht etwa zweiter Nachsatz zur Bedingung in 14, 2, da dort der erste Nachsatz im Opt. steht.—Vgl. Gl Klageeid 2. a. 13a
Judging by the fut. indic. of the verb, the sentence is not, say, a second apodosis to the condition in 14, 2, since the first apodosis there is in the opt.—Cf. Gl Klageeid 2. a. 13a
